title: pm-eng 1:1 prep - Kate Wu
content:
Purpose: quick sync with Eng Lead (Jordan) to align on priorities for next 2 weeks: API stability, Console rollout for model pinning, Dedicated capacity ETA, and Private deployment VPC tests.

Agenda:
- 5m quick wins / shoutouts
- 10m API incidents review (last 7 days) + mitigation steps
- 15m Console: model pinning UX + rollout schedule + telemetry gaps
- 10m Dedicated: capacity commit + autoscale policy changes
- 10m Private: VPC onboarding tests + KMS integration blockers
- 10m decisions / actions / blockers we need help escalate

Notes / context (things I want to surface):
- API incidents: high p99 latency spikes on hosted endpoints during batch imports (Feb 24-26). Root cause suspected: request shaping fallback to single-thread path when prefix cache miss rate > 60%. Ticket ENG-3421 opened; SRE investigating. Need to decide whether to temporarily increase batching window for affected customers as a mitigation or push kernel patch.
- Console model pinning: PM wants to ship alpha to internal beta w/in 2 weeks. Current blocker: backend doesn't expose model-variant metadata for the rollout UI (PR-678 is the backend change but needs QA sign-off). Also telemetry for per-route rollout percentage is missing from Console.
- Dedicated capacity: sales signed a verbal PO for 4 dedicated nodes for AcmeCorp with contract target Apr 1. Infra says provisioning ETA 3 weeks but we need an autoscale policy tweak to let burst capacity activate above 75% utilization. ENG-3550 covers autoscaler rules.
- Private deploys: two customers onboarding this quarter require VPC + HSM; one got stuck at VPC peering step due to IP overlap. Need runbook improvements and a simple IP conflict detection pre-check in the onboarding flow. KMS integration tests failing intermittently in ci/private-e2e.

Specific questions to ask Jordan:
- Do we have capacity to prioritize the prefix-cache fix vs. the batching-window mitigation? Tradeoffs: kernel patch has risk but long-term fix; batching-window is quick but could increase latency for others.
- Can we accelerate PR-678 QA? Who can pair with QA to unblock (Samir? eng-sre?)
- For Dedicated autoscaler, is the 75% threshold configurable per-tenant today? If not, quick path to make it so?
- For Private onboarding, can we add a pre-check step in the onboarding UI in a day-or-two, or is that a larger infra change?

Proposed decisions for 1:1:
- Approve short-term mitigation: enable +50ms batching window for customers affected by prefix-cache misses for 72 hours while Eng pushes kernel patch (owner: Eng SRE, due: 2026-03-05).
- Prioritize PR-678 QA pairing this week so Console alpha can go to internal beta on 2026-03-10 (owner: Jordan, QA owner: Samir).
- Accept Dedicated autoscaler change as a config rollout to be delivered in next sprint; if infra says ETA >2 sprints, we escalate to infra head.
- Add an onboarding pre-check for IP overlap as a MVP (UI + client-side check) to ship before next Private onboarding (owner: Solutions Eng + Kate, due: 2026-03-17).

Action items (so we can follow up post-1:1):
- Jordan: confirm SRE owner for ENG-3421 and sign off on temporary batching-window mitigation; update JIRA with chosen mitigation and ETA. (due 2026-03-05)
- Samir: pair with QA to validate PR-678; add smoke tests for model-variant metadata surface; post results in PR thread. (due 2026-03-06)
- Kate (me): draft customer comms for AcmeCorp about Dedicated provisioning timeline & burst policy behaviour; coordinate with Sales. (due 2026-03-07)
- Solutions Eng: implement IP-overlap pre-check in onboarding UI and add note to runbook. (due 2026-03-17)
- Eng-SRE: add temporary alert for prefix-cache miss rate > 50% to detect regressions. (due 2026-03-05)

Risks / unknowns:
- Kernel patch timeline: depends on low-level testing across GPU families; could slip 1-2 weeks. If so, mitigation needs to be in place longer.
- Console telemetry: if adding rollout metrics requires backend infra changes, the alpha ship date may slip. Need a minimal telemetry shim to unblock.

Follow-up items to add to next 1:1:
- Post-mitigation latency analysis (p99 before/after)
- Console alpha user feedback from internal beta
- Dedicated provisioning checklist and capacity forecasting for next quarter
- Private onboarding retrospective: what failed and updated runbooks

Quick reminders to self:
- Bring production logs extracts and simple p99 chart to 1:1 (2 slides).
- Ask Jordan about headcount ask for SRE (2 ICs) to support Dedicated growth.
- Remind Sales to get signed PO for AcmeCorp (contract/legal bottleneck).

Slack / links to reference in meeting:
- Slack thread: #inc-heap-api (see pinned messages)
- JIRA tickets: ENG-3421 (latency), ENG-3550 (autoscale), ENG-3602 (private onboarding)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/678
- Confluence: Console Rollout Plan page

Tone: keep it tactical; I want clear yes/no on the short-term mitigations and commitments for PR QA pairing.
